train_texts: Electric vehicles are becoming more popular as battery technology improves.
The range of electric vehicles is increasing every year.
Governments around the world are offering incentives for EV purchases.
Fast charging stations are critical for the widespread adoption of electric cars.
EV market share is growing rapidly in Europe and China.
Battery capacity is one of the main concerns for potential EV buyers.
Electric trucks are expected to dominate the market in the near future.
Clean energy is an essential part of the EV industry's future growth.
